acceptanceCriteria: The reusable prompt contains zero source-specific hard-coded clauses.
All four validation case types pass across two held-out source hashes.
Exact requested text is rendered verbatim and absent text produces no added typography.
Aggregate, worst-case, and generalization-gap thresholds pass on validation and sealed test.
All generation and judge models, prompts, hashes, and loss components are persisted.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths in persisted artifacts.
Use the built-in image generation tool.
Do not inspect the sealed test manifest before audit-generalization.
Do not modify completed train-0001 through train-0003 evidence.
Do not compare legacy identity-judge loss numerically with the new source-fidelity judge.
requestedWork: Train a reusable arbitrary-source style-transfer prompt with explicit optional-instruction handling and held-out overfitting checks.

optionalInstructions.pose: Show the same person standing in a full-body contrapposto pose with both hands visible.

optionalInstructions.composition: Use a square, centered product-poster composition with the clock fully visible and generous negative space above it.
